h1: AI Product Content by Industry, Picked for What You Sell
lead: Start with what you sell. One photo can become a picture or a short video, with a spoken line, an actor, a voice, captions, and music.
card: Photo and video ideas matched to what you sell.

intro: Open the category of the item you have. The page shows what shoppers look for, then you make a photo or a video from one photo.
A video can include a spoken line, an AI actor, a voice, captions, and a song from the music library. Send it to TikTok or Meta (Facebook and Instagram), or download the file.

faq.q: Which category should I open first?
faq.a: Open the category of the product you are listing. If you sell more than one kind of item, finish this one, then open the next category.

faq.q: Can I start from a phone photo?
faq.a: Yes. Use one clear photo with the whole item visible. Daylight and a plain surface make the color and shape easier to check.

faq.q: How is this different from the template library?
faq.a: These pages group ideas by what you sell. The template library groups them by layout, such as someone wearing the item, or a white background. Open a category to see the ideas. Then open a template to make that layout.

faq.q: Can one photo become both a picture and a video?
faq.a: Yes. Upload the same photo on the category page. Choose a picture template or a video template. Each one shows its credit cost before it starts.

faq.q: Do these pages tell me the ad size for each app?
faq.a: Sizes for each app are on the platform pages. These pages focus on the moment that helps someone buy. A video can be 9:16 (tall), 1:1 (square), 16:9 (wide), 4:3, or 3:4.

faq.q: Will the file keep my product's color and shape?
faq.a: The file is built from the photo you upload. Start with a picture that already shows the real color and the full shape. Check the result before you post it.

faq.q: What should a new product show first?
faq.a: Show the moment a shopper uses to decide. For a jar, show the texture. For clothes, show the fit. For a drink, show a pour. For a gadget, show it turned on.

faq.q: Can I run these files as paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. You can use the downloads for your shop, and they have no watermark. The video can include an AI voice, captions, and music from the library. Type the price yourself. Do not say anything the real product cannot do.

faq.q: Can the video include a voice and captions?
faq.a: Yes. Ask for an AI actor, a spoken line, and captions. Edit them in the editor on this site. The actor is not a real customer.

faq.q: Can I publish from the category page?
faq.a: You make the file from the category page. Then send it to TikTok or Meta (Facebook and Instagram) in one click, or download it. You still set the budget and who sees the ad in the ad account.

faq.q: Can I start this category from a product link?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a public product page. The main image and the name start the file. You still pick the template for the moment that helps someone buy.

faq.q: Can I make several versions of one item?
faq.a: Yes. A batch means several versions from the same photo. Use one for another scene or another actor. Each one shows its credit cost first.

reviews.h2: How Shops in a Category Use It
reviews.lead: Examples of how a shop would use it, not quotes from named customers.

items.d: A skincare shop starts from the jar photo, shows the texture, and adds a spoken line about one real use.
A clothing shop puts the garment on a person the tool makes. The picture does not replace the size chart.
A gadget shop asks for one motion, such as a lid opening, and puts the feature name in the captions.
A food shop shows the pour or the first sip, with music under the video and the price typed to match the listing.
A home shop places the product in a room from the photo it already has, then checks the color against the real item.
An agency makes several versions from one client photo. One version can change the actor, the first line, or the shape.
